title: ad_campaign_log
description: Memory block written by Agent 5.1 (Campaign Launcher). A paid-media campaign SETUP SPEC for Meta / Google / TikTok Ads: per-platform campaigns -> ad sets/ad groups with objective, budget, schedule, targeting, optimization, and creative references, plus a budget reconciliation against the authorized cycle budget. This is a SPEC TO BE HUMAN-AUTHORIZED, never an auto-launch instruction: gate_status is always 'pending_review' until a human grants financial authorization. Read by Layer 6 (6.1 Performance Analytics reconciles spend/ROAS/CPL against the kpi_contracts; 6.3 Optimization Engine reallocates within bounds). Reads: campaign_registry (2.2), copy_assets (4.1), page_assets (4.3), active_strategy (2.1). Human gate: financial authorization. First authored: 2026-05-29

money_usd.description: Amount in USD. USD invoicing across all four markets (constraint); local currency is reference only.

country.description: Target country, e.g. Mexico, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico.

regions.description: Optional states/regions/cities, ES-MX names (e.g. Ciudad de Mexico, Jalisco, Nuevo Leon).

segment_ref.description: Audience segment id from audience_segments / campaign_registry that this ad set targets, or 'all' if segments unavailable.

interests.description: Platform interest/affinity targets (ES-MX where consumer-facing labels).

keywords.description: Search keywords (Google Search ad groups) — ES-MX. Empty for non-search ad sets.

custom_audiences.description: Named retargeting / custom / lookalike audiences (EN config labels). Empty when none authorized.

placements.description: Platform placements (e.g. feed, reels, stories, search, youtube_shorts, tiktok_feed) or ['automatic'].

exclusions_note.description: EN. Audiences/placements explicitly excluded and why.

copy_asset_ref.description: Id of the approved copy_assets entry (4.1) used as the ad copy. Null only when no copy_assets were available (flag in setup_notes).

visual_asset_ref.description: Id of the visual_assets entry (4.2) used as the ad creative, or null if not yet produced.

landing_page_ref.description: page_id from page_assets (4.3) this ad points traffic at. Null only when no landing page is available (flag it).

destination_url.description: Final landing URL or recommended route the ad sends traffic to.

primary_text_ref.description: Pointer to the specific copy field/variant used (EN note), e.g. 'hook + primary_caption of cpy-...-01'.

ad_set_id.description: Stable id, e.g. as-meta-convocatoria-admisiones-01. On Google this is an ad group; on TikTok an ad group.

name.description: Ad set / ad group name. ES-MX where client-facing.

optimization_goal.description: What the platform optimizes delivery toward; must serve the campaign objective.

bid_strategy.description: Bid strategy; cost/bid caps recommended on conversion ad sets with a known target CPL.

bid_cap_usd.description: Optional bid/cost cap or target CPA in USD when bid_strategy uses one; null otherwise.

budget_type.description: daily = recurring per-day cap; lifetime = total over the schedule.

dayparting_note.description: EN. Optional ad-scheduling note (e.g. business hours MX time).

creatives.description: References to the approved copy/visual/landing assets the ads in this ad set use.

expected_cpl_usd.description: Modeled cost-per-lead for this ad set, EN/benchmark; null if unknown.

notes.description: EN. Setup rationale, assumptions, platform-specific caveats.

platform.description: Ad platform. meta = Meta Marketing API; google = Google Ads API; tiktok = TikTok Ads API.

platform_campaign_id.description: Stable spec-side id for this platform campaign (becomes the platform's campaign on launch), e.g. mc-meta-convocatoria-ago-01.

name.description: Platform campaign name. ES-MX where client-facing.

campaign_objective.description: Platform-level campaign objective; must serve the marketing-campaign objective in campaign_registry.

campaign_budget_optimization.description: True if budget is set at the campaign level (Meta CBO / Google campaign budget); false if per ad set.

ad_sets.description: Ad sets (Meta) / ad groups (Google, TikTok) within this campaign.

pixel_or_tag.description: Tracking asset (Meta Pixel / Google tag / TikTok Pixel) id or status note.

conversion_events.description: Events optimized/measured, e.g. lead, form_submit, page_view.

utm_template.description: UTM tagging template for landing-page attribution in Layer 6.

setup_notes.description: EN. Platform-specific setup notes, assumptions, missing-asset flags.

client_id.description: Client this campaign setup belongs to. Lowercase-hyphenated. Example: acme-co.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this setup spec was produced.

gate_status.description: FINANCIAL-AUTH gate. ALWAYS 'pending_review' on emit — paid media spends client money and must be human-authorized before launch. 'blocked' = a required upstream block (campaign_registry) is missing/empty or no funded paid campaign exists. Agent 5.1 must NEVER emit 'approved' or 'auto_approved'.

campaign_ref.description: campaign_id (from campaign_registry) this paid-media setup serves. 'none' only on the blocked path.

cycle_label.description: Marketing cycle this setup covers, e.g. 2026-Q3 or 2026-08.

currency.description: All budgets are USD. USD invoicing across the four markets (constraint); local currency is reference only.

markets.description: Markets this setup targets, e.g. Mexico, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico.

platform_campaigns.description: Per-platform campaign setup specs. Empty array ONLY when gate_status == 'blocked'.

authorized_paid_budget_usd.description: Paid-media budget available from the approved strategy / campaign_registry for this period, in USD.

total_planned_spend_usd.description: Sum of all platform campaign budgets in this spec for the period. MUST NOT exceed authorized_paid_budget_usd.

unallocated_usd.description: authorized_paid_budget_usd minus total_planned_spend_usd. Negative is an over-budget error the reviewer must reject.

by_platform_usd.description: Planned spend per platform (keys: meta, google, tiktok).

period.description: The period the budget figures are expressed in. Daily caps roll up to the monthly authorized budget.

overspend_guardrail.description: EN. The cap/guardrail recommended to the operator (e.g. 'set account spend limit = authorized monthly budget').

status.description: Financial-authorization state. Always 'awaiting_authorization' on emit; flips to 'authorized' only by a human action recorded downstream, never by 5.1.

requires_human_authorization.description: MUST be true. This agent never self-authorizes spend.

authorized_by.description: Human who authorized the spend. Null until authorized.

total_amount_at_stake_usd.description: Total monthly USD the operator is authorizing if approved (== total_planned_spend_usd normalized to monthly).

assumptions.description: EN. Material inferences the reviewer must validate (targeting estimates, benchmark CPLs, missing assets).

coherence_flags.description: EN. Problems needing a human decision (budget insufficient for objective, missing landing page, missing creative).

setup_notes.description: EN. Overall setup rationale, constraint handling, and any blocked reasons.
